cohort: 180 pregnant women presenting for antenatal care between 28 and 41 weeks of pregnancy at Social Security Landhi Hospital, Karachi, excluding those with pre-existing comorbidities (diabetes, hypertension, cardiac, renal, endocrine, liver diseases, bony disability, and history of pelvic injury).
finding: Pregnancy-related complications, both maternal and neonatal, were higher in the teenage pregnancy group compared to the ideal age pregnancy group.
mod_finding: Instrumental deliveries and Cesarean sections were more frequent in the teenage group, while normal deliveries were less frequent.
